variants.headline: Party walks out of government
variants.body: A party has walked out of the government in {colony}. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: A governing partnership breaks
variants.body: A governing party has left the colony's government. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Departure redraws the question of cooperation
variants.body: The government has lost a party from its governing arrangement. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
